method: Complete official IKEA Spain privacy text extracted by scripts/prepare-real-policies-round17.py; one reviewer froze document-category labels and questions before inference; source HTML and text stay in gitignored .cache/real_policies_round17.
annotationNotes: The English and Spanish pages are long translations of the same Spain-specific policy, not independent organizations. They test multilingual consistency and semantically difficult clauses.
Location is conditional app processing; the policy explicitly asks for consent. Optional processing counts as affirmative.
Gift Registry recipients and professional contact details are not an imported device address book. Contacts is negative.

IKEA shares data with outside service providers, while expressly denying sharing for third-party commercial purposes. Third-parties is positive because the category is broader than marketing disclosure.

Advertising is positive because commercial messages are adapted to purchase history and website browsing, including Custom Audience; an explicit denial of consequential automated decisions does not negate tailored marketing.
IKEA describes AI analysis of call and chat transcripts and a virtual assistant, but does not state that it trains AI models with customer data. AI-training is negative.
CCTV and visitor counting do not establish biometric identity recognition. Biometric is negative.

Most retention periods are fixed, but contest and event records are kept for as long as necessary for legal obligations without a definite deadline. Retention is positive under the existing category definition.

auditQuestions.en: Does optional IKEA app location processing count even when consent is required?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Cuenta el tratamiento opcional de ubicación en la app aunque exija consentimiento?

auditQuestions.en: Do Gift Registry recipient details establish access to the device address book?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Los destinatarios de la Lista de Regalos demuestran acceso a la agenda del dispositivo?

auditQuestions.en: Does IKEA share personal data with service providers despite saying it does not share for third-party commercial purposes?
auditQuestions.es: ¿IKEA comparte datos con proveedores pese a decir que no los cede a terceros con fines comerciales?

auditQuestions.en: Are IKEA's profile-based electronic marketing messages personalized advertising?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Los mensajes comerciales adaptados al perfil constituyen publicidad personalizada?

auditQuestions.en: Does AI analysis of call transcripts establish training of AI models on them?
auditQuestions.es: ¿El análisis con IA de transcripciones demuestra que se entrenan modelos con ellas?

auditQuestions.en: Does visitor counting by CCTV establish biometric identity recognition?
auditQuestions.es: ¿El conteo de visitantes mediante cámaras demuestra identificación biométrica?

auditQuestions.en: Does any IKEA retention category lack a definite deletion deadline?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Alguna categoría conservada por IKEA carece de plazo de eliminación concreto?

policies.title: Política de privacidad de IKEA España
